target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
The 2024 D049 disclosure aggregates 'Additional Capital Requirements' into a single section covering purchase obligations, R&D, and CapEx, mirroring the separate 2023 disclosures. 2023 D048 covers purchase obligations (S003) and 2023 D049 covers R&D and CapEx (S004-S005). 2024 D049 covers all these elements together (S003-S005).

The 2023 disclosure states an expectation to continue making strategic investments and acquisitions with amounts that could vary significantly. This specific sentence is present in the 2024 disclosure qcom_2024_7_D049 within the 'Additional Capital Requirements' section. While D049 covers other capital requirements, it is the only 2024 disclosure containing this specific forward-looking statement regarding strategic investments/acquisitions.
